description: List a company's direct costs (point-of-sale purchases: card/cash spend, refunds) for a data connection. NOTE: this endpoint is CONNECTION-scoped. Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/connections/{connectionId}/data/directCosts. Returns the paged envelope.

connectionId.description: The Codat connectionId (data connection UUID) within the company.

orderBy.description: Field to order results by, e.g. "-modifiedDate" (leading "-" for descending).

query.description: Codat query filter string, e.g. "status=Paid" or "modifiedDate>2026-01-01". See docs.codat.io/using-the-api/querying.

name: codat_list_direct_costs
title: List direct costs
